offering_description.value: Harmonic supplies virtualized cable and fiber access software, network equipment and managed services to broadband operators. It provides cloud software and on-site appliances for media companies to process and deliver live and on-demand video.

quotes.quote: Harmonic, the global leader in virtualized broadband, is transforming how operators deliver multi-gigabit connectivity. Our industry-leading cloud-native cOS™ platform featuring AI-powered network intelligence and end-to-end managed services empower broadband service providers to simplify their networks. We enable operators worldwide to streamline operations, boost revenues and ensure that subscribers enjoy a superior, reliable internet experience. Backed by a massive global deployment footprint and a legacy of innovation, Harmonic is the trusted partner for the next generation of broadband.
